services.title: MyTxGNN Drug Interaction Check
services.description: Demo only: no interaction check is run. The demo page shows a simulated result for two example drug pairs (prednisolone + ibuprofen, simvastatin + ketoconazole); it is not checked against the DDInter database, and this static site has no CDS service endpoint.

services.title: MyTxGNN Drug Repurposing Candidates
services.description: Demo only: illustrates a card that links to this site's TxGNN drug repurposing reports; the demo page does not look up any prediction, and this static site has no CDS service endpoint.
services.usageRequirements: Requires MedicationRequest and Condition read access

services.title: MyTxGNN Clinical Trial Matching
services.description: Demo only: illustrates a card that links to a ClinicalTrials.gov search; the demo page does not search or count trials, and this static site has no CDS service endpoint.
services.usageRequirements: Requires MedicationRequest and Condition read access
